reason: Publish #226, which gives secret-scan.yml a concurrency group so a force-pushed PR supersedes its own in-flight gitleaks run instead of leaving one alive (kodus-ai run 32215663610 sat in queued for 15h and refused both cancel and force-cancel with HTTP 500, clearing only at GitHub's 24h acquisition timeout); non-pull_request events are keyed by github.run_id so the weekly scheduled trufflehog call can never be grouped, queued behind another scan, or dropped, and cancel-in-progress is gated to pull_request so a merge_group run is never cancelled. Gate Family surface of this transition is exactly one file: audit.yml, lint-format.yml, pr-title.yml and typecheck-ts.yml are byte-identical at 4daf826 and at 7134a75, so secret-scan.yml is the only ruleset-consumed blob in the published range. Candidate validation, proportionate to a change that touches no step logic: the modified workflow ran as this repository's own pull_request-triggered gate at both PR commits (gitleaks pass at f1d0d17 and at 6270d65, the latter byte-identical to the squashed target), plus repo-wide actionlint and the 69-test contract suite. The other 30 commits in the range are inert to this tag - release-please releases, copier re-renders, a plugin-carrier sync, Renovate preset edits, and bump-brew/cloud-setup-smoke work on thin-called reusables that consumers pin by their own ref.
